remarks: Built in 1960, this charming residence hits the sweet spot and presents a rare opportunity to own a move-in ready home in a highly convenient location. The heart of the home is its updated kitchen, featuring newer cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and granite countertops, flowing into an open floor plan -living/dining area with gleaming hardwood floors throughout, a full bathroom and 2 bedrooms. Step outside from the living area to enjoy your private deck overlooking a beautifully landscaped backyard. The lower level adds valuable bonus space: ideal as a home office, gym, guest room or media room, complete with a full bathroom and flexible floor plan. Of course location is everything: walk to nearby schools, shopping and dining, with quick access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway for seamless commuting. What's not to love? Manageable scale, low-maintenance yard, updated interiors and an unbeatable location.
